testcase.name: priority scheduling fills daily capacity and returns honest totals
same-priority subjects preserve the user input order
insufficient capacity produces remaining targets and an explicit warning
unused days remain empty instead of inventing study sessions
server free time represents partial and empty days and conserves daily capacity
the algorithm preserves inputs and agrees across repeated calculations
calendar dates advance correctly across leap-day and month boundaries
minimum and maximum supported plans remain capacity-bounded
invalid dates and unsupported date representations are rejected
numeric fields reject strings, booleans, fractions and out-of-range values
subject IDs must be valid and unique and priority must be recognized
required keys and exact object/array shapes are enforced
text is trimmed, Unicode is supported, and control characters are rejected
metadata is limited to public build identity
health and version expose the expected running build identity
HTTP planning completes the browser-to-API data flow
tracing, cache and browser protection headers accompany API responses
malformed JSON, wrong media and invalid input return useful error envelopes
declared oversized requests are rejected without accepting a partial payload
chunked oversized JSON is bounded as well
unknown routes, methods and unsupported queries are rejected
local interface assets are served with correct media types and HEAD semantics
independent instances produce identical plans without server-side stored state
